definition_zh: 器具；乐器；手段
definition_en: a tool made for a task, a device for making music, or a means to an end
core_image: 墙上一排挂着的工具与乐器
scene: 琴房里小提琴斜靠在琴架上。 She plays three musical instruments.
sceneCN: 这里 instrument 是「乐器」（第 2 个义项：发声器具）；句意：她会演奏三种乐器。

derivatives.zh: instrument 加形容词后缀，义为「起作用的；器乐的」
instrument 加名词后缀，义为「乐器编配；仪表设备」
instrument 加施动者后缀，义为「器乐演奏者」

senses.title: A tool for a precise task
senses.definition: a device made to carry out careful work
senses.definitionCN: 为精细工作而造的装置
senses.example: The lab has delicate instruments.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室里有精密仪器。
senses.why: A polished tool hangs ready on the wall.
senses.whyCN: 磨亮的工具挂在墙上待命。

senses.title: A device that makes music
senses.definition: a device for playing music
senses.definitionCN: 用来演奏音乐的装置
senses.example: The violin is a string instrument.
senses.exampleCN: 小提琴是弦乐器。
senses.why: The tool is tuned until it sings.
senses.whyCN: 工具被调音，直至歌唱。

senses.title: A means to an end
senses.definition: a person or thing used to achieve a result
senses.definitionCN: 用以达成结果的手段
senses.example: Trade was an instrument of empire.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易曾是帝国的工具。
senses.why: The hung tool is taken down for larger plans.
senses.whyCN: 墙上的工具被取下用于更大的图谋。

senses.title: A formal legal document
senses.definition: a written legal paper, formal use
senses.definitionCN: 书面的法律文件，正式用法
senses.example: Both parties signed the instrument.
senses.exampleCN: 双方签署了该文书。
senses.why: The tool turns into paper with a seal.
senses.whyCN: 工具化身为盖了章的纸。

intro.en: Instrument comes from Latin instrumentum, equipment, built on instruere, to build in or prepare. A tool is knowledge built into a handle.
intro.cn: instrument 来自拉丁语 instrumentum「装备」，建立在 instruere「砌入、备置」之上；工具就是把知识砌进握柄。

items.en: Latin struere meant to build, the root behind structure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为建造，是 structure 的词根。

items.en: instruere meant to build in, arrange, prepare.
items.cn: instruere 意为砌入、布置、备妥。

items.en: instrumentum named equipment and implement.
items.cn: instrumentum 指装备与器具。

items.en: Old French instrument carried both tool and written record.
items.cn: 古法语 instrument 兼指工具与文书。

items.en: Middle English instrument added the music sense in court and church.
items.cn: 中古英语 instrument 在宫廷与教会里添了乐义。

items.en: Modern English split the senses into tool, music, means and document.
items.cn: 现代英语把词义分为工具、乐器、手段与文书。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the build-root family. The meaning group compares words of tools.
note.cn: 形近组收录「建造」词根词族；词义组比较工具类词。

entries.definition: helpful in achieving something; of music without words.
entries.definitionCN: 起作用的；器乐的。

entries.definition: plural of instrument.
entries.definitionCN: instrument 的复数。

entries.definition: teaching built word by word.
entries.definitionCN: 逐字砌成的教学。

entries.definition: a held device for work.
entries.definitionCN: 手持的劳作装置。

entries.definition: a made object for a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 为用途而造的物件。

entries.definition: a tool, especially farm work.
entries.definitionCN: 工具，多指农具。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the build root, the wall of tools and the music twist.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「建造」词根、挂满工具的墙与音乐转折。

normal.en: instruere: built-in knowledge in a handle.
normal.cn: instruere：把知识砌进握柄。

normal.en: structure, construct and instrument share one root.
normal.cn: structure、construct 与 instrument 同根。

normal.en: musical instrument is the school phrase.
normal.cn: musical instrument 是校园常用语。

normal.en: instrumental means both helpful and without vocals.
normal.cn: instrumental 兼指起作用与纯器乐。

normal.en: a signed instrument is legal paper.
normal.cn: 签署的 instrument 是法律文书。

abstract.en: One image: a wall where hammers and violins hang together.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：锤子与小提琴同挂一面墙。

abstract.en: Every instrument is a built idea you can hold.
abstract.cn: 每件 instrument 都是可以握住的建造好的想法。

abstract.en: Tune the tool until it sings.
abstract.cn: 把工具调到会唱歌。

examples.en: The surgeon checked each instrument twice.
examples.cn: 外科医生把每件器械检查了两遍。

examples.en: Learning an instrument takes patience.
examples.cn: 学乐器需要耐心。

examples.en: Diplomacy was their chief instrument of change.
examples.cn: 外交是他们变革的主要手段。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因斯特拉门特」：门特（别）灵的器械全挂墙上， instrument。

root: 拉丁语 in-「砌入」+ struere「建造」→ instruere「备置」→ instrumentum「装备、器具」→ 古法语 instrument → 中古英语 instrument；同根词 structure、construct、instruction。

sensesIntro.en: Instrument is the hung tool: a polished device, a tuned one that sings, one taken down for grand plans, and paper with a seal.
sensesIntro.cn: instrument 是挂在墙上的工具：磨亮的仪器、会唱歌的调音工具、取下谋大事的手段，以及盖了章的文书。

core.en: Knowledge built into a handle, hung on a wall until needed.
core.cn: 被砌进握柄的知识，挂在墙上待命。

branches.en: PRECISION: delicate lab instruments.
branches.cn: 精密：实验室的精密仪器。

branches.en: MUSIC: the violin is a string instrument.
branches.cn: 音乐：小提琴属弦乐器。

branches.en: MEANS: trade as an instrument of empire.
branches.cn: 手段：贸易曾是帝国工具。

branches.en: DOCUMENT: both parties signed the instrument.
branches.cn: 文书：双方签署文书。

branches.en: EQUIPMENT: tools hung ready on the wall.
branches.cn: 装备：挂壁待用的工具。

intro.en: Instrument builds instrumental, instrumentation and instrumentalist.
intro.cn: instrument 构成 instrumental、instrumentation、instrumentalist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the building verb behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的建造动词。

items.meaning: a built tool; a music maker

items.example: She was instrumental in the win.

definition_zh: 练习；实践；惯例；诊所；执业
definition_en: the repeated doing of an activity to improve a skill, the actual carrying out of an idea, a usual way of doing things, or the professional work and workplace of a doctor or lawyer
core_image: 同一段音阶被反复弹到手指自己记住，琴键上留下浅浅的指痕
scene: 琴房窗外已经黑透，节拍器还在一下一下地摆，女孩把同一段音阶又弹了一遍。 Her daily practice on the piano lasts forty minutes, even on holidays.
sceneCN: 这里 practice 是「练习」（第 1 个义项：为熟练而反复做某事）；句意为她每天在钢琴上练习四十分钟，节假日也不间断。画面里有黑透的窗、摆动的节拍器和反复弹奏的音阶。

pos.zh: 练习；实践；惯例；诊所；执业

derivatives.zh: 由 practice 的词干 practic- 加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「实际的；实用的」
practical 加 -ly 构成，义为「几乎；实际上」
由 practice 的词干加表示从业者的后缀构成，义为「从业者；执业医生」
英式拼写中以 -ise 结尾的动词形式，义为「练习；执业」，美式统一写 practice

senses.title: Repeated exercise to improve a skill
senses.definition: the repeated doing of an activity in order to become better at it
senses.definitionCN: 为了变得更熟练而反复进行某项活动
senses.example: Daily practice is the only way to play that passage smoothly.
senses.exampleCN: 每日练习是把这个乐段弹流畅的唯一办法。
senses.why: The Greek root meant doing rather than knowing, so practice begins as action repeated until the body remembers it.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根强调的是一遍遍去做，而不是想明白，所以 practice 的起点是反复行动，直到身体自己记住。

senses.title: The actual doing of an idea
senses.definition: the carrying out of a plan, belief or method in real situations rather than only talking about it
senses.definitionCN: 把计划、信念或方法放到真实情境中实行，而不只是谈论
senses.example: The new rules look fair on paper but are hard in practice.
senses.exampleCN: 新规定在纸面上看着公平，实践起来却很难。
senses.why: If the core is repeated action, the same noun can name the moment an idea leaves the page and turns into something done.
senses.whyCN: 既然核心是反复的行动，这个名词也就能指想法离开纸面、变成实际行动的那一刻。

senses.title: A usual way of doing things
senses.definition: a habit or accepted custom, especially one followed by a group or a profession
senses.definitionCN: 习惯或被普遍接受的做法，尤指某一群体或行业沿用的方式
senses.example: It is common practice to confirm a booking by email.
senses.exampleCN: 用电子邮件确认预订是常见的做法。
senses.why: What is done again and again hardens into a rule, so practice slides from one person's repetition to a group's settled custom.
senses.whyCN: 反复去做的事会慢慢固化成规矩，于是 practice 从一个人的重复，滑向一群人的既定惯例。

senses.title: The business of a professional
senses.definition: the work of a doctor or lawyer, and the place where that work is done
senses.definitionCN: 医生或律师所从事的工作，以及开展这项工作的场所
senses.example: She runs a small practice in the town centre.
senses.exampleCN: 她在市中心经营一家小诊所。
senses.why: A profession rests on practised skill, so the word comes to name the professional's ongoing work and the rooms where it happens.
senses.whyCN: 一门职业建立在反复练就的本领之上，所以这个词又用来指专业人士长期从事的业务，以及开展业务的场所。

intro.en: Practice travels through Latin and French back to a Greek word for doing, and its modern spelling split belongs to English alone.
intro.cn: practice 经拉丁语和法语上溯到希腊语中表示「做」的词，而它现代拼写的分工是英语自己后来形成的。

items.en: The verb prassein, in its Attic form prattein, meant to do, to act or to achieve, and it is the earliest recoverable source of the family.
items.cn: 动词 prassein（阿提卡方言作 prattein）意为做、行动、完成，是这一族词最早可追溯的来源。

items.en: The adjective praktikos described a person or thing fit for action, as opposed to merely theoretical.
items.cn: 形容词 praktikos 形容适合行动的、能实干的，与只停留在理论上的东西相对。

items.en: Latin took praktikos as practicus, and medieval Latin formed the noun practica for practical knowledge or the actual doing of something.
items.cn: 拉丁语把 praktikos 借作 practicus，中世纪拉丁语又造出名词 practica，指实用知识或实际去做。

items.en: Old French practique and the verb practiser carried the words into daily use, and English borrowed both in the centuries after the Norman settlement.
items.cn: 古法语 practique 与动词 practiser 把这些词带入日常使用，英语在诺曼人定居后的几个世纪里把两者都借了进来。

items.en: British English keeps practice for the noun and practise for the verb, while American English uses practice for both; the -ice and -ise endings are the everyday marker of that division.
items.cn: 英式英语用 practice 作名词、practise 作动词，美式英语则名词动词都写 practice；-ice 与 -ise 两种词尾就是这一分工的日常标记。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the spelling pair and the Latin-derived family; the near-meaning group gathers words for training, habit and real application.
note.cn: 形近组收这一对拼写以及拉丁来源的词族；近义组收表示训练、习惯与真正实行的词。

entries.definition: The British verb form, used for doing an activity repeatedly or working in a profession.
entries.definitionCN: 英式动词拼写，表示反复做某事或在某一行业执业。

entries.definition: Concerned with real action rather than with theory.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎实际行动而非理论的；实用的。

entries.definition: A person who works in a profession such as medicine or law.
entries.definitionCN: 从事医学、法律等职业的人；从业者。

entries.definition: A course of supervised practical work for students.
entries.definitionCN: 学生在督导下进行的实习课程。

entries.definition: Activity done repeatedly to train the body or the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 为训练身体或头脑而反复进行的活动。

entries.definition: A run-through of a performance before the real one.
entries.definitionCN: 正式演出之前的排练。

entries.definition: Something a person does regularly, often without thinking about it.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人经常做、往往不假思索的事。

entries.definition: An accepted way of behaving in a group or a society.
entries.definitionCN: 群体或社会中已被接受的行为方式。

normalIntro.en: The word is held together by a Greek verb for doing, a Latin adjective for fitness to act, and an English split between the noun and the verb.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词由表示「做」的希腊动词、表示「适于行动」的拉丁形容词，以及英语里名词与动词的拼写分工共同支撑。

normal.en: Greek prattein means to do, so practice is tied to action from the start rather than to theory.
normal.cn: 希腊语 prattein 意为做，所以 practice 从一开始就绑在行动上，而不是理论上。

normal.en: Latin practicus meant fit for action, and English practical keeps that sense of something usable rather than abstract.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 practicus 意为适于行动的，英语 practical 保留了「能用得上」而不是「抽象」的意味。

normal.en: British English marks the job with -ise: practise is the verb and practice is the noun.
normal.cn: 英式英语用 -ise 标出动词身份：practise 是动词，practice 是名词。

normal.en: American English drops the distinction and writes practice for both, which is why a spell-checker may object to practise.
normal.cn: 美式英语不分名词动词，一律写 practice，所以拼写检查常常会对 practise 提出异议。

normal.en: Practitioner adds a person suffix to the same stem and names someone who practises a profession.
normal.cn: practitioner 在同一词干后加上表示人的后缀，指从事某一职业的人。

abstract.en: Picture a pianist's fingers finding the keys without the eyes: practice is memory stored in the body.
abstract.cn: 想象钢琴家的手指不看琴键也能落准：practice 就是存进身体里的记忆。

abstract.en: A plan on paper becomes practice the moment someone follows it out in the rain.
abstract.cn: 纸上的计划，在有人冒着雨照着去做的那一刻才成为 practice。

abstract.en: A clinic is called a practice because a doctor's skill stays alive through seeing patients, not through holding a certificate.
abstract.cn: 诊所之所以叫 practice，是因为医生的本领靠一次次接诊维持，而不是靠一张证书。

examples.en: Her daily practice on the piano lasts forty minutes.
examples.cn: 她每天在钢琴上练习四十分钟。

examples.en: The rule works well in practice.
examples.cn: 这条规则在实践中效果很好。

examples.en: He joined a small legal practice after graduating.
examples.cn: 毕业后他加入了一家小型律师事务所。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑来个题」——考前扑来一堆题，正好拿来练手；记住 practice 是练习。

root: 希腊语 prassein/prattein（做、行动）→ 形容词 praktikos（适于行动的）→ 拉丁语 practicus 与中世纪拉丁语名词 practica（实用知识、实行）→ 古法语 practique/practiser → 英语 practice/practise。英式分工为名词 practice、动词 practise，美式为两者皆写 practice。

sensesIntro.en: The core is repeated action; from it come the doing of an idea, the custom that repetition creates, and the professional work built on practised skill.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是反复的行动；由此长出把想法付诸实行、重复所养成的惯例，以及建立在熟练本领之上的专业执业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same scale played again and again until the fingers remember it.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一段音阶被反复弹奏，直到手指自己记住。

branches.cn: 合上的琴盖旁，节拍器还在响

branches.en: a printed rule stepped on by wet boots
branches.cn: 印着规则的纸被湿靴子踩过

branches.cn: 每家店门口重复的同一句招呼

branches.cn: 靠每日重复与每日病患维持的本领

senses.title: A part of a place
senses.definition: a part of a town, a country or the world
senses.definitionCN: 城镇、国家或世界的一部分
senses.example: This area of the city is very quiet.
senses.exampleCN: 城市的这一片区域非常安静。
senses.why: The Latin word named open ground, so a stretch of ground marked off is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词指开阔地面，所以划出来的一片地面就是第一义。

senses.title: The size of a surface
senses.definition: the amount of flat surface measured in square units
senses.definitionCN: 以平方单位量出的平面大小
senses.example: The area of the room is twenty square metres.
senses.exampleCN: 这间房间的面积是二十平方米。
senses.why: Measuring that open ground turns a stretch of space into a number of square units.
senses.whyCN: 量一量那片空地，就把空间变成若干平方单位。

senses.title: A field of activity
senses.definition: a subject or a part of activity that has its own limits
senses.definitionCN: 有自身边界的一个学科或活动范围
senses.example: She works in the area of science.
senses.exampleCN: 她在科学领域工作。
senses.why: A ground marked off can also be marked off in thought, which gives the sense of a field of work.
senses.whyCN: 地面上划出的一块也能在思想上划出，于是有「工作领域」。

normal.en: Spell it as it sounds: keep every letter of area in order.
normal.cn: 按读音拼写：把 area 的每个字母按顺序保留。

senses.title: A situation or set of facts

senses.example: In that case, we will take the earlier bus.

senses.title: A single example or instance
senses.definition: one particular example of a general kind
senses.definitionCN: 某一类里的具体一例
senses.example: The patient was an unusual medical case.
senses.exampleCN: 这位病人是一个罕见的病例。
senses.why: Each happening is one item that falls out of the stream of events.
senses.whyCN: 每一次发生，都是事件之流中落下的一件。

senses.title: A legal matter in court

senses.example: He put the guitar back into its case.

senses.why: The word also kept a second Latin cousin, capsa, meaning box.

definition_en: one or the other of two; used after a negative to mean also not
core_image: 双手各托一样东西，让你挑任意一边
scene: 餐桌上摆着两只杯子，妈妈让孩子随便挑一杯。 Take either cup, the milk is the same.
sceneCN: 这里 either 是「任意一个」（第 1 个义项：两者之一）；句意是随便拿哪只杯都行，奶是一样的。图中可辨识物件：餐桌、两只杯子、牛奶、孩子的手。

senses.title: One or the other of two
senses.definition: one or the other of two people or things
senses.definitionCN: 两个人或物之中的任意一个。
senses.example: Take either cup, the milk is the same.
senses.exampleCN: 随便拿哪只杯都行，奶是一样的。
senses.why: The old root meant one of two, so either keeps the image of two choices side by side.
senses.whyCN: 古词根本义即「两者之一」，either 保留了两个选项并排的画面。

senses.title: Also not, after a negative
senses.definition: used after a negative statement to add another negative
senses.definitionCN: 用于否定句后补充同样的否定。
senses.example: I do not like it either.
senses.exampleCN: 我也不喜欢它。
senses.why: The parallel sense grew out of listing two items, one of which is also excluded.
senses.whyCN: 并列义源于列举两项而其中一项同样被排除。

senses.title: Correlating two alternatives
senses.definition: used with or to present two alternatives
senses.definitionCN: 与 or 搭配提出两个可选方案。
senses.example: Either you apologize, or you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 要么道歉，要么离开。
senses.why: Pairing either with or builds a fork in the road, one branch to be chosen.
senses.whyCN: either 与 or 搭配搭出岔路口，两条分支必选其一。

intro.en: Either and its sister neither go back to one old word meaning each of two.
intro.cn: either 与它的姊妹词 neither 源自同一个表示「两者各一」的古词。

items.en: Old English oegther, from oegther, meaning each of two.
items.cn: 古英语 oegther，意为「两者各一」。

items.en: The root aiwaz or aiz, a Germanic word for a group of two, spread across the family.
items.cn: 词根 aiwaz 或 aiz，表示「一组两个」的日耳曼词，传遍语族。

items.en: Middle English either took its modern shape and began the either... or... pattern.
items.cn: 中古英语 either 形成现代形态并开启 either...or... 结构。

items.en: Modern English uses either for choices, and neither for double negation.
items.cn: 现代英语用 either 表选择，neither 表双重否定。

items.en: Pronunciation split into British and American variants over the centuries.
items.cn: 数百年间读音分化出不列颠与美利坚两种变体。

note.en: Either lives between choice words and negative twins.
note.cn: either 处于选择词与否定孪生词之间。

normal.en: In negatives, either means me too, but not.

definition_zh: 水平面；水平；级别；平整的；夷平
definition_en: a flat surface or height; a position in a scale; flat and even; to flatten completely
core_image: 水面静止时那道绝对平直的线
scene: 雨停之后，湖面平得像一面镜子。 Pass the exam and you reach the next level.
sceneCN: 这里 level 是「级别」（第 3 个义项：等级、级别）；句意为通过考试就能升到下一级。

derivatives.zh: level 加 -ly，指「平稳地；平静地」
level 加 -ness，指「平坦；平整」
level 与 head 合成，指「头脑冷静的」

senses.title: A flat, even surface or line
senses.definition: a surface or line that is flat and even all across
senses.definitionCN: 整体平整的表面或线条
senses.example: The table top is perfectly level.
senses.exampleCN: 桌面完全水平。
senses.why: The picture is the still line of water: nothing tilts, nothing dips.
senses.whyCN: 画面是静止的水线：无倾斜、无低垂。

senses.title: A height measured against a standard
senses.definition: a height or position measured from a reference point
senses.definitionCN: 相对于基准的高度或位置
senses.example: The flood rose above ground level.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水涨过了地面高度。
senses.why: Measuring compares the water line to everything else, so height borrows the flat line.
senses.whyCN: 测量把水线与其他一切相比，高度便借用这条平线。

senses.title: A position in a scale
senses.definition: a rank or stage in a series of amounts or abilities
senses.definitionCN: 数量或能力序列中的等级或阶段
senses.example: Pass the exam and you reach the next level.
senses.exampleCN: 通过考试就能升到下一级。
senses.why: A scale is drawn as flat steps, each step one level of the ladder.
senses.whyCN: 标尺被画成平直的阶梯，每阶即一级。

senses.title: An amount or concentration
senses.definition: an amount or degree of something present at a time
senses.definitionCN: 某物在某时的数量或程度
senses.example: Noise levels drop at night.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间噪声水平下降。
senses.why: The reading is a height on the gauge, so amounts climb and fall like water.
senses.whyCN: 读数是仪表上的高度，数量如水位涨落。

senses.title: Flat and even; fair
senses.definition: flat, even, or equal in position or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 平的、等高的，或待遇对等的
senses.example: The two teams played on a level field.
senses.exampleCN: 两队曾在平整的场地上比赛。
senses.why: Even ground gives no one an advantage, and fairness keeps the same image.
senses.whyCN: 平地不偏向任何人，公平沿用同一意象。

senses.title: To flatten or destroy
senses.definition: to make flat, especially by demolishing
senses.definitionCN: 使平坦，尤指拆除推平
senses.example: The quake levelled whole streets.
senses.exampleCN: 地震把整条街道夷为平地。
senses.why: Building up in reverse is tearing down to the flat line.
senses.whyCN: 逆向施工就是把一切拉回水平线。

senses.title: To become steady (level off)
senses.definition: to stop rising or falling and become steady
senses.definitionCN: 停止升降趋于平稳
senses.example: Prices levelled off after the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 假日后价格趋稳。
senses.why: The rising line finally lies flat, like water finding its own level.
senses.whyCN: 上升的线最终躺平，如水归于水平。

intro.en: Level comes from Old French nivel, from Latin libella, a diminutive of libra "scales, balance"; the flat line of a balance gave the flat surface its name.
intro.cn: level 来自古法语 nivel，出自拉丁语 libella（libra「天平、秤」的指小词）；天平的平直横线给了平面这个名字。

items.en: Latin libra meant scales or balance, the tool whose beam stays flat.
items.cn: 拉丁语 libra 指天平或秤，其横梁保持平直。

items.en: Latin libella, a small balance, named the carpenter\u0027s tool for checking flatness.
items.cn: 拉丁语 libella（小天平）命名了木工测量平直的工具。

items.en: Old French nivel kept the tool sense and the flatness sense together.
items.cn: 古法语 nivel 同时保留工具义与平坦义。

items.en: Middle English spread level to heights, scales of rank, and fairness.
items.cn: 中古英语把 level 扩展到高度、等级序列与公平。

items.en: Modern English added the verb of flattening and the steady-price sense level off.
items.cn: 现代英语新增夷平动词与 level off 价格趋稳义。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists flatness and rank words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出平坦与等级之词。

entries.definitionCN: 撬杠；出自拉丁语 levare「抬起」，词根不同。

entries.definition: In a calm, even manner.
entries.definitionCN: 平稳地；平静地。

entries.definition: Smooth and even; level stresses the horizontal line.

entries.definition: A step in a scale or school year.
entries.definitionCN: 等级或年级中的一级。

entries.definition: A position in a hierarchy.
entries.definitionCN: 层级中的位置。

entries.definition: To tear down buildings; matches the flattening verb.
entries.definitionCN: 拆除建筑；对应夷平义。

normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用拉丁天平与真实短语。

normal.en: Latin libra, the scales, is the sign of balance in the zodiac.

normal.en: The tool for checking flatness is called a level.
normal.cn: 检验平直的工具就叫 level（水平仪）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: level off, sea level, level with someone.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：趋稳、海平面、坦率相告。

normal.en: British doubles the l: levelled, levelling.
normal.cn: 英式双写 l：levelled、levelling。

normal.en: A level playing field means fair conditions for all.
normal.cn: level playing field 指对所有人公平的条件。

abstract.en: Picture wrecking balls leaving nothing but a flat lot.
abstract.cn: 想象破碎球过后只剩一片平地。

abstract.en: Picture a price line that stops climbing and lies flat.
abstract.cn: 想象价格曲线停止爬升、躺平不动。

examples.en: Water always finds its own level.
examples.cn: 水总会找到自己的水平面。

examples.en: Her French is at an advanced level.

examples.en: The old factory was levelled last year.

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses all lean on one flat line: surfaces, measured heights, scale steps, readings, fairness, flattening, and steadying prices.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项都倚仗同一条平线：平面、量得的高度、等级阶梯、读数、公平、夷平与价格趋稳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the unchanging flat line of still water.
core.cn: 核心意象：静水那道不变的平线。

branches.en: THE LINE AND ITS HEIGHT: flat surfaces and heights measured from them.
branches.cn: 线与高度：平面及以其为基准的高度。

branches.en: THE SCALE: ranks and readings climb the same ladder.
branches.cn: 标尺：级别与读数爬同一架梯子。

branches.en: EVEN TREATMENT: fairness keeps the ground equal.
branches.cn: 对等对待：公平让地面均等。

branches.en: TEARING DOWN: destruction reduces all to the flat line.
branches.cn: 推倒：破坏把一切拉回平线。

branches.en: FINDING REST: lines and prices settle level at last.
branches.cn: 归于平静：曲线与价格最终持稳。
